label: Airbus A350-1000 · Trent XWB-97
axes: X aft; Y up; Z port

a350Extension.mainGear: Two three-axle bogies; original strut retraction pivots drive the additional axle meshes
a350Extension.basis: Airbus AC A350 Rev 17, 2-2-0, Fig. 991-001 and 991-002. Engine front station moves aft 3.81 m and total length increases 6.99 m.

reverserCascades.basis: Original illustrative turning vanes fitted inside source translating-sleeve geometry; not engine engineering CAD.

fidelityNotes: The -1000 uses two barrel additions, fitted panes, and three-axle main bogies. The inboard wing and Trent XWB nacelle are adapted from the A350 donor. Internal landing gear engineering and -97 subassembly surfaces are approximate.

authoredPaint.method: Original airline paint layout projected in physical exterior coordinates; independent destination texture atlases retained.
